The key and the a"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ccount both follow the official Models page, and the endpoint is the official one — none of the thre"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"llow the official Models page, and the endpoint is the official one — none of the three is set here."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Data and credentials"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The balance is read directly from the official DeepSeek API, not estimated from usage."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- The credential is resolved through DSH's credential channel; the plugin stores no key of its own: "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"a key never lands in a settings file.
- The UI only ever sees a **head-and-tail mask** (`sk-cf08d***"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"**3b84`, the same shape the DeepSeek platform console uses); **the full key never crosses the wire**"},{"id":"p9s4","text":", is never logged, and is never written to any file of this plugin.
- Only `api.deepseek.com` is con"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"tacted; no other traffic is proxied or forwarded.

That `pnpm install` cannot be skipped: under a path install the "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"repository supplies its own dependencies, and missing them makes the plugin show as "not running"."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## What it shows"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Three surfaces, each with one job:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Surface | Where | What it does |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Status ring | Pinned to the bottom of the sidebar | See at a glance how much is left and how close"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" you are to the warning threshold |
| Balance popover | Click to expand | See the total, the granted"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" / topped-up split, and how many minutes old the data is |
| Settings card | This plugin's details p"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"age under Plugins | Check both ways of reading your balance, and set the currency, the warning thres"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"holds and the refresh cadence |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The entry is pinned to the bottom of the sidebar; clicking it opens the balance popover: the total, "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"the granted / topped-up split, how many minutes ago the data was, and manual refresh at the bottom r"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ranted / topped-up split, how many minutes ago the data was, and manual refresh at the bottom right."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The ring itself is "what is going on right now", five states you can tell apart at a glance:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| The ring | Meaning | What you do |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Coloured ring + an arc | There is a balance; the colour says more or less | Read the number |
| Gr"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ey ring + a rotating gap | Fetching, no result yet | Wait |
| Grey ring + a **+** in the middle | No"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"t connected to your account yet | Configure it |
| Grey, empty ring | Connected to your account, whi"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"ch simply has no balance | Nothing |
| Red ring + a **cross** in the middle | No usable number here "},{"id":"p25s5","text":"s no balance | Nothing |
| Red ring + a **cross** in the middle | No usable number here | Check it |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## What each thing is"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Thing | What it means |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Arc length | The balance as a share of that currency's **warning threshold**, capped at a full cir"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"cle |
| Colour | State only (normal / low / critical), never the amount; the **critical threshold on"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ly sets the colour** and takes no part in drawing the ring |
| The mark in the middle | **+** means "},{"id":"p28s4","text":"not connected yet; go configure; **cross** means no usable number here — it could not be read, or it"},{"id":"p28s5","text":" was read but the account cannot be used |
| Hover text | The **amount** when the number is trustwor"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"thy, that state's own line otherwise; collapsed and expanded say the same sentence |
| The source br"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"acket | To the right of the popover title: which credential this number came from — a head-and-tail "},{"id":"p28s8","text":"mask such as `sk-cf08d*****3b84`, or the signed-in account's name |
| Data freshness | The "how long"},{"id":"p28s9","text":" ago" in the popover, counted from the moment the data arrived |
| Manual refresh | Cooldown applies"},{"id":"p28s10","text":"; the cooldown restarts when the refresh finishes, and the seconds on the popover are the real ones "},{"id":"p28s11","text":"left |
| Settings groups | Connection / Display / Thresholds / Refresh |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The card lives on the Plugins page: sidebar **Plugins** → "Installed" → click the **DeepSeek Balance"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"** card to step into its details page."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The configuration area is on the details page, right below the description, ready to edit:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **Connection** — read-only: the two ways this plugin can read your balance, what each one is using"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" right now, where that credential comes from, and a **Test** button that really calls the provider.
"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"- **Display** — which currency amounts use, or let it follow the account.

If you need the settings UI, upgrade the host to the newest line: `npm install -g @deepseek-ai"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"/dsh@next`.
- **The declaration enumerates lines explicitly**: only the lines listed in `engines.dsh"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"` are promised. A new line past the ceiling becomes supported only after it has been measured in the"},{"id":"p34s6","text":" compat.yml matrix and written into the declaration; it does not follow the host automatically. **Pa"},{"id":"p34s7","text":"tch releases inside a listed line (prereleases included) need no declaration change**.
- **Compatibi"},{"id":"p34s8","text":"lity is measured**: weekly, compat.yml runs the tests on the declared host line, plus a separate ste"},{"id":"p34s9","text":"p checking the declared range still covers it; a red committed line opens a tracking issue.
